The recital finds that the public interest requires that the employee be exempted from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year, and the operative sentence, under section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932 (47 Stat. 382, 404), exempts Hervey G. Mooney from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending October 31, 1941. That exemption is the order's only command and it carries its own fixed term. First end: the order's own stated end, October 31, 1941 (operative sentence: "for a period of one year ending October 31, 1941."). The stated date is recorded inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of October 31, 1941); the exclusive reading, under which it ends when October 31, 1941 begins, is the alternative. The date is the end of the stated term, not a record of separation or death; no such record is held.
